skill.name: image-edit
skill.description: Edit, vary, restyle, transform, or repair existing images through the hosted Luxin runtime and its image editing models.
skill.summary: Run guided image edits with hosted assets, recoverable jobs, cost controls, receipts, and structured results.
skill.author: danielgwilson

security_audit.summary: Twelve static findings are confirmed because the workflow executes remote packages, accepts a server-provided command, contacts a hosted API, and writes hidden agent state. Twelve findings are false positives involving Markdown formatting or documentation links, while semantic review also identifies hosted image persistence and diagnostic data disclosure.

remediation.issue: The workflow permits execution of a command returned by the hosted service.
remediation.suggestion: Parse and allowlist the returned subcommand and arguments, then require explicit user confirmation before execution.

remediation.issue: Examples execute mutable npm and GitHub sources with automatic confirmation.
remediation.suggestion: Pin exact package versions and repository commits, verify integrity, and remove automatic confirmation flags.

remediation.issue: Input and generated images can remain on a third-party hosted service.
remediation.suggestion: Request consent before upload and document retention, access controls, deletion, and public URL behavior.

remediation.issue: The fallback changes HOME and CODEX_HOME to hidden workspace directories.
remediation.suggestion: Use an explicit workspace installation path and warn users to exclude agent state and credentials from version control.

remediation.issue: Feedback can disclose attempted commands and observed behavior.
remediation.suggestion: Show the payload, redact prompts and identifiers, and require opt-in before sending diagnostics.

content.user_title: Edit Images Through a Hosted Agent Workflow
content.value_statement: Image editing often requires provider accounts, local models, and separate billing. This skill guides hosted edits with cost limits, durable assets, and recoverable jobs.
actual_capabilities: Guides no-spend readiness checks for the OpenAI GPT Image 2 edit model.
Edits an existing image identifier with a natural-language prompt.
Supports variations, restyling, transformations, repairs, and model-specific parameters.
Applies a maximum estimated cost per image before a paid edit.
Returns structured results with hosted assets, jobs, and cost receipts.
Provides a hosted feedback workflow for missing capabilities or unexpected behavior.
limitations: Requires network access to Luxin and access to remote npm packages.
Input images and generated assets can be stored by a third-party hosted service.
Paid creation depends on available credits and explicit permission for media spending.
The examples use mutable latest package versions and do not provide integrity verification.

use_cases.title: Revise Campaign Artwork
use_cases.description: Replace backgrounds or repair details while preserving the main subject and controlling estimated cost.

use_cases.title: Produce Product Variations
use_cases.description: Create controlled visual variations from an existing product image for review or testing.

use_cases.title: Automate Image Repairs
use_cases.description: Run repeatable image edits with structured job records and durable output references.

prompt_templates.title: Simple Background Change
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit this image by replacing the background with [setting]. Keep the subject, pose, lighting direction, and proportions unchanged.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs one focused edit.

prompt_templates.title: Controlled Restyle
prompt_templates.prompt: Restyle this image as [style]. Preserve [elements], avoid [changes], and keep the final composition suitable for [use].
prompt_templates.scenario: A user needs a visual variation with clear constraints.

prompt_templates.title: Targeted Repair
prompt_templates.prompt: Repair [problem area] without changing [protected areas]. Match the surrounding texture, color, lighting, and perspective.
prompt_templates.scenario: A creator needs a localized correction.

prompt_templates.title: Production Edit Specification
prompt_templates.prompt: Transform [input] for [channel]. Preserve [requirements], change [details], enforce [policy constraints], and keep estimated cost below [amount].
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced workflow needs operational, policy, and budget controls.

output_examples.input: Replace the office background with a neutral studio wall while keeping the person unchanged.
output_examples.output: The edit completed with a durable hosted asset, recoverable job reference, and cost receipt.

output_examples.input: Repair the damaged corner of this product photo and preserve all printed labels.
output_examples.output: The repaired image preserves the labels and matches the surrounding surface, lighting, and perspective.

output_examples.input: Create a watercolor variation and keep the composition suitable for a square social post.
output_examples.output: The variation applies a watercolor treatment while retaining the subject placement and square composition.

best_practices: State the exact area to change and list elements that must remain unchanged.
Run the no-spend guide before creation and set a strict estimated cost limit.
Obtain consent before uploading images and review the hosted service retention policy.
anti_patterns: Do not execute a server-provided command without inspecting every argument.
Do not upload confidential images without authorization and an approved retention plan.
Do not use mutable latest packages in unattended or privileged environments.

faq.question: Does this skill require a local image model?
faq.answer: No. It uses the hosted Luxin runtime and does not require a local model server.

faq.question: Do I need provider API credentials?
faq.answer: No provider credentials are required. Luxin may use an optional restricted hosted token.

faq.question: Can it edit an existing image?
faq.answer: Yes. The main workflow accepts an existing image identifier, an edit model, and a natural-language prompt.

faq.question: How are costs controlled?
faq.answer: Use the no-spend guide first, then set a maximum estimated cost per image before creation.

faq.question: Where are edited images stored?
faq.answer: The workflow returns durable hosted media URLs. Review Luxin retention and deletion terms before uploading sensitive images.

faq.question: Can failed jobs be investigated?
faq.answer: Yes. Jobs are designed to be recoverable, and the skill provides a hosted feedback command for missing capabilities.
